summary: Anthropic published a case study describing how the Government of Alberta used Claude Code (Opus and Sonnet) with parallel autonomous agents to scan, fix, and modernize hundreds of millions of lines of government code for cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

mechanisms.reason: The case study shows autonomous multi-agent systems performing large-scale code review and remediation work that would otherwise require years of human labor, illustrating agents displacing traditional labor-intensive workflows.
mechanisms.quote: the team estimates that that kind of review could otherwise have taken around 6.5 years

mechanisms.reason: The deployment of roughly 50 autonomous agents working in parallel to scan, diagnose, and remediate vulnerabilities across millions of lines of code demonstrates a long-horizon, tool-using agentic capability beyond simple code completion.
mechanisms.quote: Around 50 agents worked autonomously and in parallel to scan the systems for security vulnerabilities, weaknesses in underlying infrastructure and deployment processes, and gaps in technical documentation.
